rows.en:
(Today I'm having fun at the Mihoshi pool
with Klan-senpai again!)

Come on, let's get in the pool, Klan-senpai.
What are you doing over at the poolside?
W-well, I do want to play in the pool, but...
"But"?
rows.notes: Both genders. Echoes Klan's trailing 'omou no da ga'.

rows.en: The truth is, I forgot my float ring...

Hmm, that's a problem.
And it suited you so well, you looked just like
an elementary schooler any way you look at it...

That's not the problem~!!
Making fun of me again, are you?
I'll teach you a lesson!

(I meant it as a compliment...
And she didn't have to kick me into the pool......)

(Today I'm having fun at the Mihoshi pool
with Klan-senpai again!)

(Klan-senpai suddenly called me out here.
I wonder what's going on?)
Sorry for calling you out so suddenly.
No problem. More importantly, what's up?

Mm. Actually, there's something
I want to ask your advice about...

My advice?
I hope I can be of some help...

I'm sure you'll do fine!
Will you hear me out?

You know how I turn into a little kid
when I micronize, right?
rows.notes: Both genders. youjika = regress into a small child.

rows.en:
I want to do something about
these far-too-clumsy genes of mine!
rows.notes: Both genders. 'Clumsy genes' as Klan's card (c24216).

rows.en:
What a limp answer!
Pull yourself together!
rows.notes: Both genders. Reacts to a player reply not in this slice (no row between c07899 and c07900 in the dump).

rows.en:
Well, I do want to help you, Senpai,
but when it comes to genetics and stuff,
there's no way I could...
Hm, it seems I've given you the wrong idea.

That's not what I mean.
To put what I want from you simply...
Simply put?
W-with your own hands......
rows.notes: Both genders. Continues into c07906 (deliberate double meaning).

rows.en: I want you to make me a grown woman!!
rows.notes: Both genders. Keeps the double entendre that makes the player panic and the cafe staff glare (c07911, c07937).

rows.en: ...Huh?
Whaaaaaaaaat~~~!!!

Uhh...
So you mean you want me to help you look like
a grown woman even when you're micronized?
Exactly.
rows.notes: x4: Klan here (both genders), Ozma in scd_sms_807. Generic.

rows.en:
Then just say that...
Thanks to you, Klan-senpai, I'll feel awkward
ever going back to that shop......
rows.notes: Both genders. The scene takes place in a shop/cafe (see c07929, c07937).

rows.en: S-sorry...

Sigh...
But I get what you're trying to say, Klan-senpai.

I don't know how much I can do,
but I'll help you as much as I can.
Thank you. I owe you one.
rows.notes: Both genders. sumanai here is thanks.

rows.en: Let's do our best from here on.
Mm, I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Both genders. Klan relies on the player.

rows.en: A-and also, about this...
......It's a secret, just between us two, okay?
Heh heh, got it, Klan-senpai.
(I don't know how much help I can be, but...)

(I'll do my best to turn Klan-senpai
into a grown-up lady!)

(Klan-senpai suddenly called me out here.
I wonder what's going on?)

My advice?
I hope I can be of some help...

Well, I do want to help you, Senpai,
but when it comes to genetics and stuff,
there's no way I could...

I don't know how much I can do,
but I'll help you as much as I can.
(I don't know how much help I can be, but...)

(I'll do my best to turn Klan-senpai
into a grown-up lady!)
(Klan-senpai called me out to a cafe, but...)
rows.notes: Both genders. kissaten = cafe (no accent: Shift-JIS).

rows.en: There you are, \p.
Oh, Klan-senpai...
rows.notes: x4: player here and in frd_kln_110, both genders.

rows.en:
What's wrong? Don't be shy,
hurry up and take a seat.
I'd like to, if I could, but...
Then just sit down.
Well, but, you see...

What? Stop mumbling.
What on earth is the matter?
rows.notes: Both genders. hagire no warui yatsu.

rows.en:
...Because of what you said last time,
Klan-senpai, the staff are giving us
ice-cold looks!
rows.notes: Both genders. tenin rendered 'the staff' (number and gender unknown).

rows.en: So I want to get out of here, fast!!
Right, we're leaving at once!

(I'm not tough enough to enjoy my tea
under the staff's ice-cold stares...)

(I'm not tough enough to enjoy my tea
under the staff's ice-cold stares...)

(Klan-senpai called me out, saying there was
something she wanted me to see.
What could it be?)

(Maybe it's about what she asked me
the other day? But still...)
Why are we in the Pilot Course warehouse?
This was the only good spot I could think of.

Good spot...?
What exactly are you planning to do,
Klan-senpai?
A fashion show!
A fashion show?

I bought all sorts of clothes to look like
a grown woman, and I want you to judge
whether I really do.
I see, so that's what this is about.

And now, the Klan Klang Fashion Show
begins!!
rows.notes: Both genders. Full name as in the Japanese.

rows.en: You can come in now.

(So, what kind of clothes
did Klan-senpai buy?)
Well? Does it suit me?

Uhh...
I think it suits you, but......
...That's a Nyan-Nyan uniform, isn't it?
Mm, that's right.

The slit up the leg gives off a subtle hint
of grown-up allure, does it not?
Uhh... Klan-senpai......
rows.notes: x4: male and female, this scene.

rows.en: Hm? What is it?
rows.notes: x6: Klan in frd_kln_006 and frd_kln_008, both genders.

rows.en:
It suits you really well, and I do think
it's cute, but...
Hmm?

uncertain: c07900: Klan scolds a 'limp reply' but no player row sits between c07899 and c07900 in the dump; presumably a reply elsewhere in the script (shared row) or a choice. Rendered as is.
c07906 kept as the double entendre 'make me a grown woman' so that c07911 (awkward to go back to that shop) and c07937 (staff glaring) make sense.
c07937/c07940 tenin rendered 'the staff' (one clerk or several, gender unknown).
c07931 is also a player line in frd_kln_110; checked it works there ('Oh, Klan-senpai...').
